title: Interface measured: Lighthouse and the Playwright suite against the real API
platform: Windows 11, 8 logical CPUs at 100 % load from other local jobs (Docker builds, embeddings) during every run; port 4710 was held by a local Docker stack, so the preview ran on 4720 through VIGIE_WEB_PORT
api_setup: python -m vigie.api on 127.0.0.1:8731, VIGIE_LLM_PROVIDER=fake, hybrid Qdrant index of the corpus, real guard model, throwaway token store in a gitignored folder

steps.name: live suite before the fix, seen red
steps.command: cd web && VIGIE_API_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:8731 VIGIE_E2E_TOKEN=<test token> npx playwright test -c playwright.live.config.ts
steps.result: 5 passed, 1 failed: the usage screen shows a server error against the real API (schema mismatch). The answer test passed only through the JSON fallback, which hid that the page never streamed.

steps.name: live suite after the fix
steps.command: cd web && VIGIE_WEB_PORT=4720 VIGIE_API_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:8731 VIGIE_E2E_TOKEN=<test token> npm run e2e:live
steps.result: 6 passed, the answer now arrives on /v1/ask/stream as text/event-stream

steps.name: mocked suite after the fix
steps.command: cd web && VIGIE_WEB_PORT=4720 npx playwright test
steps.result: 54 passed, axe scans and visual baselines included

steps.name: build and initial JS budget
steps.result: initial JS 26.7 KB gzip, budget 120 KB

steps.name: Lighthouse with the installed Chrome 154
steps.result: every run fails with NO_NAVSTART: Lighthouse 12.6.1, the version @lhci/cli 0.15.1 ships, cannot read the trace of Chrome 154

steps.name: Lighthouse, mobile, median of 3
steps.command: cd web && VIGIE_WEB_PORT=4720 CHROME_PATH=<playwright chrome-headless-shell> npx lhci autorun --collect.url=http://127.0.0.1:4720/ --collect.url=http://127.0.0.1:4720/about --collect.startServerReadyPattern=4720
steps.result: all assertions of web/lighthouserc.json pass. Home: performance 98, accessibility 100, best practices 100, LCP 1841 ms, CLS 0.001, TBT 137 ms. About: 99, 100, 100, LCP 1656 ms, CLS 0, TBT 72 ms.

steps.name: screenshots and journey recording
steps.command: cd web && VIGIE_WEB_PORT=4720 npx vite preview, then node scripts/capture-proofs.ts <dir>, GIF made with ffmpeg (fps 8, width 800)
steps.result: 12 screenshots (desktop 1440 and mobile 360, light and dark) and docs/assets/web/parcours.gif
